patterns.note: The hero section employs an asymmetrical layout, placing prominent text content on the left and a large, custom 3D illustration on the right, creating a dynamic visual balance.

The hero section features a complete 3D scene transition on scroll; the initial 'developer at desk' illustration and accompanying text are replaced by a new 'developer standing with boxes' scene, and the navigation items gain a background.
A consistent warm, light beige background (#dfd1bc) is used across the entire page, providing a soft and inviting canvas that allows the custom 3D illustrations and dark text to stand out.
The 'Projects' section utilizes a responsive grid of uniformly styled cards, each featuring a small icon, project title, and a subtle call to action, maintaining visual consistency.

technique_notes: The site leverages WebGL and Three.js to render highly detailed, custom 3D illustrations that serve as the primary visual elements. The hero section implements a sophisticated scroll-triggered animation where an entire 3D scene is dynamically replaced and animated into view, rather than simply parallaxing elements, creating a strong visual narrative as the user scrolls.
Content sections are presented with a clean, minimal aesthetic, using ample whitespace and a clear typographic hierarchy to ensure readability and focus on the custom 3D artwork.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4x body) paired with smaller, regular sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on interactive elements and card components.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero section with generous vertical spacing, transitioning to a balanced grid layout for content sections.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its extensive and sophisticated use of custom 3D illustrations, powered by WebGL/Three.js, which dynamically transform and animate on scroll to tell a visual story. This goes beyond typical static imagery or simple parallax, creating a highly engaging and memorable experience.
